🤯Disappear from Meetings With Snap

Built this Chrome extension using Meta’s Muse AI (got early access)

Just snap your fingers, turn into particles, disappear from the call, and get auto-muted at the same time. 👀

The crazy part? I didn’t write a single line of code.

I described the idea, and Muse planned the workflow, wrote the code, and gave me a file to install directly in Chrome.

From idea to working extension in minutes. 🤯

Comment “SNAP” and I’ll send you the extension + the complete workflow.

#AITools #MuseAI #MetaAI #ChromeExtension
